author: blu
body: Proves Stream of Life. "{X}{G}: target player gains X life." is authored as the GainLifeX marker; the engine pours spare mana into X and gains the caster X life. GainLifeX is a cast-time marker (no-op in apply-effect). The demo casts it for X=4 and checks the caster is at 24, and the card is in the graveyard.
